places.name: Cyprus Museum (National Archaeological)
places.ai_summary: The Cyprus Museum is the largest and oldest archaeological museum in Cyprus, showcasing artifacts from the Neolithic to Byzantine periods.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Aphrodite statue exhibit.

places.name: Leventis Municipal Museum
places.ai_summary: Leventis Municipal Museum is dedicated to the history and culture of Nicosia, featuring artifacts, photographs, and documents.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for local crafts.
